title: Presidential Candidates on an Intense Schedule This Wednesday (9)
subtitle: Rallies, motorcades, and meetings with productive and real estate sectors mark the day
excerpt: This Wednesday (9), presidential candidates' schedule includes rallies, a motorcycle motorcade, leaflet distribution, interviews, and meetings with sector representatives.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
The presidential candidates' schedule for this Wednesday (9) includes a series of campaign activities. Among the planned events are rallies and public meetings, which typically gather supporters in public places to present proposals.

Street Mobilization

In addition to rallies, the agenda features a motorcycle motorcade—an action involving motorcyclists supporting the candidate—as well as leaflet distribution and direct engagement with supporters.

Meetings and Interviews

The presidential hopefuls also have interviews and hearings scheduled, moments dedicated to clarifying their stances and debating relevant topics. Meetings with representatives from the productive and real estate sectors are also on the agenda, along with visits to institutions, aiming to strengthen relationships with various segments of society.

With information from Agência Brasil.
